Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of PRINCIPAL GOVERNMENT POLYTECHNIC PORBANDAR payable at STATE BANK OF INDIA PORBANDAR . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 10. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of PRINCIPAL GOVERNMENT POLYTECHNIC PORBANDAR A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 11. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Transportation, installation, inspection, and demonstration of practical on equipment must be carried ou t by the seller at buyer’s location without any additional cost. 2. All Accessories & Consumables comes under the scope of supply of seller. 3. Replacement of components during warranty period must be carried out by the seller without any additi onal cost. 4. Standard experimental manual must be provided by the seller. 5. The jurisdiction of any dispute claim will be at Porbandar. 6. Bidder’s Average Annual Turn Over of previous Three Financial Years must be at least Rs. 1,65,160/- or more and proofs (as mentioned in Gujarat State Procurement Policy - 2024) regarding that must be submit ted. 7. EMD and Performance Bank Guarantee are applicable as per the latest Gujarat State Procurement Policy - 2024. a. EMD as per the rate of 3% of Bid Estimated Value (3% of Rs. 82,580/- = Rs. 2,478/-) is to be submitted. b. EMD is to be submitted in form of Demand Draft in favour of “PRINCIPAL GOVERNMENT POLYTECHNICPO RBANDAR”, Pay Order or Bank Guarantee only from banks approved by Finance Department, Gujarat. c. Original EMD is to be submitted compulsorily in office during office hours on or before Bid Ends. Otherwi se, the bidder will be disqualified. d. Also, Soft copy of EMD is to be uploaded on GeM portal while bidding. Otherwise, the bidder will be disq ualified. e. e-PBG as per rate of 5% of L1 Value is to be submitted by L1 Bidder in favor of “PRINCIPAL GOVERNMEN T POLYTECHNIC PORBADAR” after Bid awarded successfully. .
